Fixes a settings-push script that reported success while doing nothing.

`scripts/push_settings.sh`, added in v19.34, piped `key=value` pairs into `python -`.
That form reads the program itself from standard input, so the pairs were never read.
The script exited zero, printed nothing, and left the live server untouched — the worst
shape a deployment tool can take, because it looks like it worked.

Values are now passed as arguments, written, read back and compared. Any mismatch, or
any unknown setting name, fails the script with a non-zero exit.
